description: Lists every country, city and zone where CoworkingView has coworking spaces, with the exact slugs required by the other tools and how many spaces each place has. A "zone" is a district inside a city (for example "mitte" inside "berlin"). Call this before searching whenever the user names a place, because every filter takes a lowercase slug and a guessed slug returns an empty result rather than an error. Also answers "which cities do you cover?" directly.

country.description: Optional ISO country code or country slug to narrow the list, e.g. 'DE' or 'germany'. Omit to list everything.

locale.description: Language for names and descriptions. Set from the user's language: 'de' for German, 'es' for Spanish, otherwise 'en'.
